ValidationRule.description: A new branding request must go to a vendor in the retailer's own hub. Same logic as the return-case rule, keyed to this case type so either can be retired independently.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Case_Type__r.Name = "Branding & Marketing Asset Request", NOT(ISBLANK(Vendor__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Retailer_Hub__c))), TEXT(Vendor__r.Hub__c) <> TEXT(Retailer_Hub__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Selected vendor's hub does not match the retailer's hub. Choose a vendor mapped to the retailer's hub.
